title: Report: Kyle Monangai to have MRI on knee, Bears believe he avoided serious injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Kyle Monangai to have MRI on knee, Bears believe he avoided serious injury
sources.description: Running back Kyle Monangai made an early exit from Bears practice on Sunday after hurting his knee, but the team's current belief is that he avoided a major injury.
